facts.fact: The three operators signed a binding tripartite agreement to operationalise Horizon Fiber, a terrestrial fibre corridor from Djibouti's submarine cable gateways through Ethiopia to Sudan, signed at a ceremony in Djibouti; the document gives no day, so the published date is used.

systems.owner: Djibouti Telecom, Ethio telecom and Sudatel Group
systems.tiers: operators; hyperscalers and carriers as prospective customers
